**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is (e.g. I'm always frustrated when [...]).

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision it working.

**Describe Alternatives You've Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, tools, or workarounds you've considered.

**Component Affected**
- [ ] Skill sync / catalog (`scripts/sync.py`)
- [ ] MCP Server (`mcp/sfp_mcp.py`)
- [ ] Skill Hive / Prediction engine (`mcp/sfp_hive.py`)
- [ ] Local model router (`mcp/sfp_route.py`)
- [ ] IDE extension (`extensions/antigravity-hive`)
- [ ] Documentation / Recipes
- [ ] Other

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, code snippets, or mockups about the feature request here.
